items.rationale: Translating the police report for the claim is a substantiation cost the policyholder bears (3.1.6, 7.1.8(f)), so it is not indemnified.
Working materials raised alongside an excluded translation charge are excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

Robbery abroad is covered. 7.1.9 first limits the line to a like-for-like replacement (about EUR 7,000), then the valuables sub-limit of EUR 2,500 per item applies (4.2.2/4.4), within the EUR 5,000 away-from-home limit. Deducting the EUR 150 deductible once per event, here on this line (7.8), gives 2,500 - 150 = EUR 2,350.
About EUR 900 cash was taken, but the means-of-payment sub-limit is EUR 500 per event (2.3.2, 4.2.3), so the line is EUR 500. The deductible was assumed to come off the watch line.
The sunglasses were lost on a separate occasion without force or threat, so they are excluded under 2.3.4(a) and are not an affected item under 7.1.10.
Carriage and delivery charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
